text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive or coordinating connector that attaches the certified misguidance report to the prior rebuke
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the clause attached to the preceding address while allowing a fresh evidentiary turn. The reader hears the misguidance report as cumulative proof in the ongoing rebuke, and the compact particle onset helps the certified claim arrive with clipped pressure before the main verb.

topics.headline: resumptive continuity into certified accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the report is not detached narrative but a connected step in the running rebuke.
topics.reason: QAC marks a conjunction prefixed to the certified clause, and the clause evidence keeps the report joined to the surrounding rebuking discourse.

topics.headline: clipped onset before the heavy verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short opening particle as part of a compressed launch into the certified event.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete sound-and-position payoff tied to the visible particle sequence before the verb.

words.gloss_range: emphatic prefix in the la-qad assertion, strengthening the following completed event rather than governing a noun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the emphatic prefix in the certified opening, not a local preposition. It front-loads force before event and agent appear, so the audience meets the misguidance as an already pressed claim inside the bound la-qad formula.

topics.headline: emphasis before the event appears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certainty is placed before the misguidance event rather than added after it.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as emphatic before the certification particle and perfect verb, so the pre-verbal position strengthens the whole event claim.

topics.headline: bound la-qad compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prefix as fused into the la-qad certification stack rather than as an independent lexical item.
topics.reason: The surface sequence binds the prefix to the following certification particle in a compact assertion formula.

words.gloss_range: certifying particle before the perfect verb, marking realized past misguidance as established evidence
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) makes the past misguidance a verified, accomplished premise. Its separate slot after the emphatic prefix and before the perfect verb turns the later question into a demand for inference from known evidence, while the clipped particle triplet seals the onset before the heavier verb.

topics.headline: verified realized past
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the harm is treated as established past evidence, not as a possible future risk.
topics.reason: QAC marks a certification particle before the perfect verb, and the clause evidence licenses the completed event as the premise of the assertion.

topics.headline: past evidence becomes the rebuke premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the later question is accusatory: it asks why already certified evidence did not produce reason.
topics.reason: The first clause is the established verbal report and the second is the rebuking negative question, so the particle helps convert past damage into the premise for blame.

topics.headline: clipped certification cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short certification particle as the close of the compressed onset before the main verb expands.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete sound-position effect attached to the visible particle sequence.

words.gloss_range: completed causative misguidance: an agent has led a human collective off the known path as an accomplished event
words.root_gloss_range: root range of loss, straying, disappearance from the way, and caused misguidance; the local Form IV perfect selects completed induced misorientation with an affected human object
words.prose: {{ar:أَضَلَّ}} ({{tr:aḍalla}}) is a completed active Form IV verb, so the clause presents caused misorientation with a responsible recoverable agent and a direct affected object. The path-loss image remains positive and local because the prior ayah has just supplied the straight-route frame; the word is not vague confusion. Comparative rows sharpen the point without taking over the parse: divine-testing misguidance in 2:26 contrasts with the local satanic precedent, the mass-scale pairing recalls 7:179, the misguidance/reason pressure appears at 25:44, and the same-surah d-l-l thread at 36:24 and 36:47 returns here as causative evidence before the final reason demand.

topics.headline: completed causative agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misguidance is inflicted through a causative verb, not left as passive drift or self-contained error.
topics.reason: QAC gives Form IV perfect active, and attachment evidence makes the following collective the direct object of the caused action.

topics.headline: path-loss image after the straight path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb as caused departure from an already defined route, while local grammar keeps it within completed causative misguidance.
topics.reason: The root field supports loss of way and error, and the prior path frame gives that image local force; broader root possibilities are not treated as independently active.

topics.headline: known misguidance becomes reason evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the completed misguidance is the premise from which the final reasoning rebuke is launched.
topics.reason: The asserted verbal clause precedes the rebuking question, making the caused event the basis for judging the audience's reasoning.

topics.headline: comparative misguidance field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader gains controlled contrast from other misguidance, quantity, and reason pairings without letting those parallels govern the local parse.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels and same-surah links, but attachment and QAC keep the local word as Form IV caused misguidance with a direct object.

words.gloss_range: partitive/source phrase from among you, binding the misled multitude to the addressed audience
words.prose: {{ar:مِنكُمْ}} ({{tr:minkum}}) makes the misled multitude come from within the addressed group. The fused preposition and second-person plural suffix bind sourcehood to direct address before the object phrase appears, so the later accusation remains on the same collective. Even the sound note serves that grammar by making the partitive phrase heard as joined to the following mass noun.

topics.headline: from among the addressed audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the harmed multitude belongs inside the audience's own circle, not outside their concern.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the phrase as making the following collective a partitive group from the addressees.

topics.headline: same addressees carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one collective through source, accusation, and the later reason-demand.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix agrees with the later second-person verbs, preserving the same addressee chain.

topics.headline: fused source phrase with audible binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the source relation compressed into a single bound phrase before the mass object.
topics.reason: The word combines preposition and suffix, and the source row ties the sound pressure to the following object phrase.

words.gloss_range: formed human collective as direct object: an indefinite mass of people, not a named or countable group
words.root_gloss_range: root range around mountain mass, formation, created constitution, and human stock; the local noun selects a formed human collective rather than a literal mountain
words.prose: {{ar:جِبِلًّۭا}} ({{tr:jibillan}}) is the accusative direct object: the group is the patient of caused misguidance, then the following adjective locks quantity onto it. Lexically it is a formed human mass, not a list of individuals and not a literal mountain; the mountain-heavy root field gives density while the local object role selects human collective stock. Variant and qiraat rows are useful as apparatus because they expose cohort, vocalic, and mass pressures without replacing the canonical object. The inter-ayah evidence is similarly controlled: 26:184 clarifies created-generation language, while the mass-and-abundance field at 22:18 helps the reader feel how a formation term becomes human loss here.

topics.headline: direct affected collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the collective is the direct patient of the caused misguidance and the pivot of the object phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as the accusative object of the verb and as the head qualified by the quantity adjective.

topics.headline: formed human mass, not literal mountain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the object as a dense formed people-mass while local grammar keeps the selected sense as a human collective.
topics.reason: The root field includes formation and mountain-mass pressure, but the local noun is an affected human collective rather than a literal mountain object.

topics.headline: variant forms illuminate scale without replacing the surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that alternate vocalizations and generation-language cluster around the same large human object slot, while the canonical surface remains governing.
topics.reason: The variants test vocalic weight, cohort language, and compactness, but all are held to the same object role and do not override the aligned surface.

topics.headline: marked root field and inter-ayah mass pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an unusual human-collective form stands out against a mountain-dominant root field and joins abundance into a marked scale warning.
topics.reason: The concrete references and distributional rows sharpen markedness and scale, while the local syntax still selects the direct human object.

words.gloss_range: uncounted abundance qualifying the affected collective, adding scale without a finite number or comparison
words.root_gloss_range: root range of increase, multiplicity, abundance, and comparative greaterness; the local adjective selects sheer uncounted abundance, not comparative ranking
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرًا}} ({{tr:kathīran}}) is not a comparative ranking or a count; it is an indefinite accusative adjective that binds abundance to the misled object. It doubles the scale already present in the collective noun and seals the object phrase immediately before the rebuking turn. The wider quantity/reason field is useful but limited: 36:7 moves from majority language to this many-ness, 5:103 links many with failure to reason, 7:179 ties abundance to misguidance, and 25:44 keeps quantity and reason under judgment without changing the local adjective into a separate proposition.

topics.headline: uncounted abundance bound to the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that quantity belongs inside the harmed object phrase and remains large without being numerically counted.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word an accusative adjective qualifying the collective object, and the indefinite form prevents a finite count.

topics.headline: abundance added onto collectivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the adjective does not merely repeat the collective noun; it makes an already formed mass quantitatively overwhelming.
topics.reason: The local phrase stacks a collective noun with a qualitative abundance adjective, so scale becomes a grammatical and semantic payoff.

topics.headline: scale seals the phrase before rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears abundance as the landing point of the affected-scope phrase just before the question turns accusatory.
topics.reason: The adjective follows the object and precedes the interrogative pivot, while the shared case ending and cadence bind it to the object phrase.

topics.headline: quantity and reason parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader gains a controlled sense that Quranic many-ness often becomes evidence for failed reason, while the local word remains an adjective of scale.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete same-surah and cross-surah parallels, but local attachment keeps the force adjectival inside the object phrase.

words.gloss_range: interrogative-consequential pivot that turns the established report into rebuking accountability
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) fuses interrogative challenge with consequential sequencing. The report has just become established evidence, and this segment turns that evidence into direct accountability rather than a neutral request for information. Its compressed position before the negator makes the pivot feel sudden and prosecutorial.

topics.headline: question plus consequence becomes rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question arises from the evidence and carries censure, not curiosity.
topics.reason: Translation support marks the negative interrogative as rebuking, and the particle combines question force with consequential sequencing.

topics.headline: pivot from report to direct accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah shift from a third-person report into a direct demand that the audience answer for itself.
topics.reason: The particle opens the second clause, which contains second-person verbs and functions as the rebuking turn after the assertion.

topics.headline: compressed onset into negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pivot as rapid and compressed before the negated reasoning state is named.
topics.reason: The source rows tie the visible fused segment and prosodic compression to the immediate onset of the negated question.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator over the copular reasoning frame, denying a maintained state rather than a single thought
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs the following copular verb and lets the negation reach the whole being-plus-reason predicate. The rebuke is therefore not merely that one act of thought failed, but that a reasoning condition was absent where the evidence should have produced it. In the same second-person frame, the negation keeps the commanded audience under forensic blame.

topics.headline: negation over the reasoning state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negator denies a maintained state of reasoning, not only an isolated mental act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows the negator governing the copular verb, which in turn takes the reason verb as predicate.

topics.headline: past negation becomes censure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question as reproach for an expected state that should already have existed after the evidence.
topics.reason: The negative interrogative clause is marked as rebuking, and the past negation through the imperfect supports the charge of absent rational condition.

topics.headline: visible jussive dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negation grammatically bind the following verb before the reason predicate arrives.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark the particle as governing the following jussive/collapsed copular form.

words.gloss_range: negated second-person plural copular condition: whether the addressees were people characterized by reasoning
words.root_gloss_range: root range of being, becoming, occurrence, constitution, and state; the local copular form selects a negated communal condition governed by the following reason predicate
words.prose: {{ar:تَكُونُوا۟}} ({{tr:takūnū}}) inserts a being-state frame before the final reason verb. Because it is second-person plural and governed by the negator, the ayah asks the same addressed collective why reasoning was not its condition, not simply whether an episode of reasoning occurred. The direct second-person surface blocks a distancing third-person reading, while the being-field parallels remain controlled: 36:82 contrasts decisive being-command with this missing state, 67:10 voices later regret over not having reasoned, and 40:67 with 22:46 show the broader being-and-understanding field without changing the local copular construction.

topics.headline: lam-governed plural copula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the plural audience still visible inside a negated dependent copular form.
topics.reason: The negator governs the second-person plural copular verb, whose plural ending keeps the collective subject visible.

topics.headline: reason as maintained condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rebuke deepen from did you reason to were you people characterized by reasoning.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following reason verb the predicate of the copula, so the construction tests a state rather than a bare event.

topics.headline: same collective directly confronted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same second-person collective from source phrase to accused reasoning subject.
topics.reason: The second-person plural morphology and boundary continuity keep the addressees as the direct subject, while variant contrast clarifies what the canonical form does.

topics.headline: being-field parallels under local control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader gains contrast from other being-and-reason scenes while keeping the local sense as a negated copular condition.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels and same-surah contrast, but the local construction remains governed by the negator and specialized by the reason predicate.

topics.headline: copula delays the reason word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the copula postpones the reason verb so reasoning becomes the clause-ending test.
topics.reason: The construction routes the question through the copula before reaching the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: ongoing second-person plural reasoning/restraint as final predicate, demanded without an explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: root range of binding, restraint, understanding, and rational judgment; the local verb selects ongoing rational restraint without an explicit object
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿqilūn}}) closes the ayah with ongoing rational restraint rather than object-specific knowledge. Because the verb has no explicit object, the demand generalizes over the whole evident situation: known mass misguidance should have bound judgment and impulse. As the predicate after the copula, it names the condition the audience lacked; as the final word, it becomes the criterion by which the whole report is judged. The parallels are controlled but pointed: 2:44 supplies the familiar reason-question formula, 67:10 turns non-reasoning into later regret, 36:68 repeats the reason-root at another rebuke line, 25:44 pairs misguidance with reason pressure, and 5:103 links many-ness with not reasoning.

topics.headline: objectless demand for reasoning capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no explicit object narrows the demand; reasoning is required as a general response to the evidence.
topics.reason: The verb instance is marked with no overt object, and translation support warns against adding an object where the Arabic remains compressed.

topics.headline: ongoing second-person predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reasoning as an ongoing practice expected of the same addressed plural, not a single completed act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the verb the predicate of the copular construction, with second-person plural subject continuity.

topics.headline: restraint beneath understanding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels reason as disciplined restraint and judgment, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as active reasoning in the clause.
topics.reason: The root family supports binding and restraint pressure, but the local verb remains the basic active reason predicate rather than a separate tether action.

topics.headline: final word as counterweight to misguidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by naming the faculty that should have answered caused misguidance.
topics.reason: The final-word position after the certified misguidance report makes reason the closure criterion and the internal answer to induced straying.

topics.headline: reason formula and echo field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader gains inter-ayah resonance for the reason rebuke while the local wording remains governed by its copular, objectless predicate frame.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete formula, regret, same-surah, quantity, and misguidance pairings, but they serve as controlled parallels rather than replacements for the local parse.

topics.headline: final sound joins reason closures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final ending reinforce reason as a repeated endpoint of rebuke.
topics.reason: The sound row gives a local closure payoff tied to the final word and the same-root return at 36:68.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative ض ل ل, the ج ب ل plus ك ث ر object, and the closing ع ق ل question.
baseline_models.mechanism: An adversarial agent moves a very large human aggregate away from guidance, while rational discernment should have checked that movement and restrained participation in it.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the off-course event assigned by the causative verb to the adversary.
Mountain-scale abundance supplies the great human aggregate affected by the deviation.
Numerical increase intensifies the scale rather than changing the kind of aggregate.
Intellect that checks ignorance supplies the failed counterforce to being led off course.

changed_reading.before: He misled many of you; did you not understand?
changed_reading.after: He drove a vast human aggregate off purposeful guidance; why did discriminating restraint not arrest that movement?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unusual ج ب ل noun is modified by ك ث ر inside the object of causative ض ل ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object can be heard not merely as a count of separate persons but as a densely gathered, created human stock whose shared formation has become a medium of misguidance.

activation_trace.role: Departure from right direction remains the governing event for the collective object.
Created constitution supplies the sense of a human stock formed with shared dispositions.
A huge mountain-like collectivity gives that formed stock social density and scale.
Coalescence into a dense quantity makes multiplicity function as a collective formation.

changed_reading.after: Misguidance has penetrated a densely formed human collectivity, not merely accumulated isolated errors.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ت ك و ن plus ت ع ق ل places reasoning inside a state-of-being question.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wording asks whether rational restraint ever occurred or persisted as their condition, making the reproach durative rather than a complaint about one missed thought.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make reasoning a state that should have become actual and sustained.
Discernment that restrains ignorance defines the expected enduring capacity.
The tether image turns sustained reasoning into active holding rather than passive possession.

changed_reading.before: Why did you not think at the relevant moment?
changed_reading.after: Why was rational self-restraint never present as an operative condition among you?

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence supplies an offered bridle and straight route, then collars and barriers, then a preserved covenant beside the adversary's long cord. This strengthens a reading of ع ق ل as voluntary inner binding: failure to hold oneself to the route permits hostile pull and culminates in imposed fixation.

activation_trace.role: Off-course motion is the focus event whose control mechanism the context clarifies.
A camel tether supplies the focus image of deliberate self-binding against drift.
A bridle within wisdom supplies an early instrument for governing otherwise uncontrolled motion.
The straight road gives the directional norm from which the focus multitude departs.
A collar fastening the body materializes restraint after it is no longer voluntarily exercised.
Barriers closing gaps before and behind turn failed navigation into spatial confinement.
A preserved pact supplies the normative bond to which inner restraint should have held.
A long tightening cord supplies a rival pull immediately before the focus reports mass deviation.
The repeated straight road places the focus question directly after a renewed directional norm.

structural_cues: The straight road appears near the opening at 36:4 and again immediately before the focus at 36:61.
Collars and front-back barriers at 36:8-9 precede the covenant, adversary, route, and failed-reason sequence at 36:60-62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bridle, routes, collars, walls, a preserved pact, and a long cord; I infer a movement from rejected inner restraint to adversarial pull and imposed fixation. A live alternative is that the collars and walls depict condition or consequence without this causal staging.

changed_reading.before: Did you not intellectually recognize Satan's misguidance?
changed_reading.after: Why did you not bind judgment to the covenantal route before the adversary's pull and external bonds fixed your course?

context_deltas.mechanism: Generations, dispersed descendants, and the sons of Adam extend the focus multitude through lineage; universal gathering then reverses crowd cover by sorting and witnessing. The vast formed mass is therefore both the medium through which misguidance scales and the collective from which accountable persons must be distinguished.

activation_trace.role: Created constitution anchors the multitude as human stock rather than an abstract number.
Mountain-like abundance gives that stock collective scale.
Numerical predominance supplies the social pressure by which multitude can masquerade as validation.
People bound within one era divide the aggregate into successive historical cohorts.
Smallness spreading outward gives descendants a dispersive mechanism across the collective.
Rejoining what was scattered brings every cohort into one present aggregate.
Sorting one thing visibly from another reverses the anonymity of the assembled mass.
A mental power that extracts meanings bridges judicial sorting to the discernment missing in the focus.
Lineage traced to an origin names the addressed multitude as a transgenerational family.
Evidence declared from knowledge assigns responsibility after the crowd has been separated.

structural_cues: A lone man comes from the city's far edge at 36:20 against a rejecting population, so numerical isolation does not mark error.
Destroyed generations are all brought present at 36:31-32; the same all-gathered movement at 36:53 is followed by separation at 36:59 and bodily testimony at 36:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cohorts, descendants, lineage, gathering, sorting, and testimony; I infer that crowd formation transmits and conceals error until judgment individuates it. A live alternative is that these are separate resurrection scenes without a social mechanism for the focus multitude.

changed_reading.before: Satan happened to mislead a large number of individuals.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance scales through a transgenerational crowd whose numerical force cannot excuse anyone, because the gathered mass will be sorted back into accountable witnesses and actors.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heedlessness, reminder, preserved traces, repeated signs, the repeated reason refrain, and forgetting one's own creation form a memory circuit. This activates the lost-preservation branch of ض ل ل: misguidance is not lack of evidence but failure to retain and relate what has already been marked.

activation_trace.role: Loss of what should be preserved recasts deviation as a breakdown of moral memory.
Understanding that checks folly supplies the operation that should retain and connect evidence.
Leaving something outside wakeful attention names the initial failure of retention.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies the corrective memory operation.
A remaining mark that discloses what occurred makes past conduct available to recollection and inference.
Visible markers repeatedly arriving yet being turned aside show that evidence is supplied but not integrated.
The repeated appeal to restraining understanding links the focus failure to an observable life-cycle reversal.
Loss of remembered origin provides the surah's explicit late example of reasoning severed from its own evidence.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly labels earth, night, and the carried descendants as signs at 36:33, 36:37, and 36:41, then describes recurrent turning away at 36:46.
The focus question is echoed at 36:68, and the final disputant at 36:78 forgets the very creation from which the required inference should begin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting, remembrance, residual marks, visible signs, and repeated reason language; I infer that reasoning here means retaining and comparing those data over time. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between heedlessness and cognition without a specific memory mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They lacked enough understanding to identify misguidance.
changed_reading.after: They repeatedly let disclosed signs, remembered origin, and preserved traces fall out of relation, so misguidance operated as failed retention rather than missing evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated ك و ن forms surround the focus with former conduct, fixed placement, and sudden becoming; aging is then inverted and the ع ق ل refrain repeated, before the closing command of being. The focus construction therefore indicts the absence of a durable rational mode of being across changing states.

activation_trace.role: Presence and occurrence through time anchor reasoning as an actual condition.
Discernment that checks ignorance defines the quality expected to inhabit that condition.
Formerly present conduct makes habitual being the object of exact recompense.
Place and standing turn a condition into something on which a person can become fixed.
Life extended through time gives the interval across which rational recognition should mature.
Turning a thing upside down makes changing condition materially observable.
The repeated reason refrain explicitly applies discernment to temporal reversal.
Immediate coming-to-be closes the surah with the maximal contrast to reason that never became operative.

structural_cues: Former-state constructions cluster at 36:54 and 36:63-65 around the focus's own state-of-being question.
The same reason refrain follows age reversal at 36:68, while 36:82 closes with an explicit command and occurrence of being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated being forms, habitual deeds, fixed state, temporal inversion, and immediate becoming; I infer an aspectual-ethical emphasis on reason as a durable condition. A live alternative is that most being forms are ordinary auxiliaries and carry little independent force.

changed_reading.before: The auxiliary wording merely asks whether they ever thought.
changed_reading.after: Across a lifetime of changing and witnessed states, rational restraint never became their stable operative mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enumeration, exact recompense, a secured covenant, sealing, testimony, and bodily acquisition form an audit chain. The compensation branch of ع ق ل then activates a secondary legal sense: the question asks why they did not bind themselves by advance reckoning of liability before the evidence was closed.

activation_trace.role: A fixed compensatory liability supplies the exploratory bridge from reasoning to accountable reckoning.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies a complete record before judgment.
Matching an act with its return makes the recorded account consequential.
A secured undertaking carrying recourse or guarantee gives the command a liability-bearing bond.
An assured preventing seal closes one channel of self-presentation in the audit.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies admissible evidence from the body.
Acquisitive limbs connect what was earned to the very organs that testify.

structural_cues: Deeds and their traces are written and counted at 36:12 before the judgment scene.
Exact recompense at 36:54 leads through the covenant at 36:60 to sealed mouths and testifying limbs at 36:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, matched return, warranty, sealing, testimony, and acquisitive limbs; I extend the compensation branch of ع ق ل into anticipatory self-reckoning. The materially live alternative is the primary cognitive sense, with the legal branch contributing imagery but not a distinct reading.

changed_reading.before: Why did you not understand the prohibition?
changed_reading.after: Why did you not reckon and bind yourselves against liability under the preserved covenant before the record and bodily evidence settled the account?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-maps human moral agency to livestock handling and uses distant rope and animal branches. It remains anchored in the focus's strayed-beast branch of ض ل ل and camel-tether branch of ع ق ل, while 36:60 supplies the adversary's long cord and 36:71-72 supplies owned, subdued cattle. Downstream prose should render it only as a secondary material analogy, not as a claim that ج ب ل literally means herd or that humans lack agency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative ض ل ل, the huge ج ب ل plus ك ث ر object, and the ع ق ل closing question support a controlled straying-and-tethering analogy.

activation_trace.role: An ownerless animal left astray supplies the zoomorphic shape of the causative deviation.
Being driven onto an affair gives the huge collective an exploratory compelled-cohort force.
Great number expands the straying image from one animal to a human-scale drove.
Tethering a camel supplies the absent countermeasure: deliberate self-restraint.
A long tightening cord gives the adversary a rival means of directing the collective.
Livestock and camels make the focus tether image materially present later in the surah.
Ownership and disposal give humans control over the animals and sharpen the reversal of agency.
Taming and making tractable supplies the animal-control operation humans receive but fail to internalize.

changed_reading.before: Satan misled many people who failed to think.
changed_reading.after: The adversary's rival cord drove a huge human drove astray; those who master tethered livestock failed to exercise the inward halter of reason.

strongest_changes: Reason becomes active self-binding to a route and covenant, contrasted with hostile pull, collars, and barriers.
The huge formed multitude becomes a transgenerational crowd that judgment gathers, sorts, and returns to individual evidence.
Misguidance becomes failed retention of reminders, signs, origin, and traces rather than a mere shortage of information.
The state-of-being construction becomes a reproach for reason never becoming a durable operative condition.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus's restraint imagery unusually concrete: wisdom as a bridle, reason as a tether, straight roads, external bonds, a preserved covenant, later sorting, and the exact reason refrain at 36:68. It also exposed a contained animal-control reversal and a branch-distant legal account that a conservative reading would likely flatten.
remaining_uncertainties: The created-stock and compelled-cohort branches of ج ب ل may be lexical coloration rather than active senses of the focus noun.
The compensation and livestock-tether readings are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant and should not displace the primary cognitive reading.
The repeated ك و ن pattern may carry durative ethical force, or most instances may function only as ordinary auxiliaries.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mass scale does not make a course rational.** `ض ل ل` B001 is straying; `ج ب ل` B002 mountain-like abundance; `ك ث ر` B001 numerical increase; `ع ق ل` B001 understanding as restraint. The huge number led astray is set against the absent restraint of reason. I infer that intellect should tether movement against crowd momentum. The ayah reads as critique of numerical validation.
2. **Innate formation can be redirected.** `ج ب ل` B004 is formed nature; `ع ق ل` B002 tethering with a hobble. I infer that created disposition alone does not secure direction; it requires active restraint from hostile leading. This makes the question about reasoning practical, not merely cognitive.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:77-78 supplied an individual instance of failed restraint: the human opponent's argument becomes abundant speech because he does not tether it to memory of his own origin.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mass misdirection becomes mountain-like social terrain.** **ض ل ل B001** anchors deviation from the route; **ج ب ل B002** supplies mountain-like multitude in **جِبِلًّا**; **ك ث ر B001** abundance; and **ع ق ل B001** understanding as restraint. The straight path is immediately prior (36:61), while the promised destination of deviation follows (36:63–64). Those are supplied; the inferred arrow is *large-scale accumulated following makes error feel as solid and given as terrain, but reason should tether the individual against its slope*. The ayah contrasts social mass with restraining discernment.
2. **Created disposition is not an excuse for unreason.** **ج ب ل B004** supplies innate formed nature, and **ك و ن B001** anchors the past state in **تَكُونُوا۟**. The nearby covenant addresses the entire lineage (36:60), not one constitution. The packet supplies formation, command, and failed restraint; the abduction is *whatever disposition the multitude was formed upon remained answerable to a faculty capable of checking it*. This reading preserves nature and responsibility without collapsing either.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:66–67 converts failed restraint into bodily-spatial incapacity: sight can be erased and form can be made unable to go or return. The mountain-like social obstruction thus culminates as loss of the very interfaces needed for self-correction.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedensel irilik ve kalınlığı, hörgüç ile deri ve kemik gibi özel gerçekleşmeleri ve kalın kuru nesne kullanımını birlikte destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal doğuştan huyu değil, bedenin veya nesnenin gözle görülür irilik, kalınlık ve sertlik özelliklerini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bedensel irilik yalın ve bağlı biçimlerde görülür; yüz, baş, kadın ve nesne kullanımları kendi yapılarıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bedenin iri, kalın veya kaba yapılı olmasını belirtir; özel kullanımlarda hörgüç, yüz ya da baş dokusunun kalınlığını ve bir nesnenin kalın-kuru oluşunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir insanın veya hayvanın beden bakımından iri ve kalın yapılı olmasını belirtir.
Hörgücün büyüklüğüne, yüz derisinin kalınlığına ya da baş derisi ve kemiklerinin kalınlığına uygulanır.
Bedenden bağımsız bir nesnenin kalın ve kuru olmasını bildiren sınırlı bir kullanımı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı bedensel irilik ve kalınlıktır; hörgüç, deri, kemik ve kalın kuru nesne bunun özel uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bedensel irilik ve kalınlık; kalın ve kuru olma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bedensel çekirdeği ve nesneye özgü sınırlı uzantıyı birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İrilik, kalınlık, beden bölümleri ve kuru nesne uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın ya da hayvanın genel beden yapısının anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Genel bedensel irilik ve kalınlık çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hörgüç ve deri ayrıntılarıyla kalın kuru nesne kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız bedenden bağımsız bir nesnenin kalın ve kuru niteliğini anlatan kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin kalın ve kuru olması özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bedensel irilik ile özel beden bölümlerine ilişkin kullanımları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli beden bölümleri ile nesne uzantısını içerir; komşu ise genişlik, sertlik ve güçlü hayvan betimlemesine uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir varlığın yaratılıştan taşıdığı yapıyı ve onun belirli bir yapıya veya huya göre yaratılıp biçimlendirilmesini açıkça tanımlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kazı yapan kişi veya topluluğun kazılamayacak kadar sert zemine ya da kayalık katmana ulaşmasını açıkça anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kazı ve sert zemine ulaşma yapısına bağlıdır; yalın bir sertlik veya dağ anlamına genellenmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, kazının sert bir yere varması ve bu sertliğin kazmayı artık olanaksız kılmasıdır.

concept_gloss.text: kazarken kazılamayan sert zemine ulaşma

error_profile.preserves: Kazı, sert zemine ulaşma ve kazının durması aşamalarını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, çokluğu azlığın karşıtı ve sayının artması olarak kurar; ayrıca bir şeyin çok duruma gelmesini, çok duruma getirilmesini ve ondan çokça edinilmesini de açıkça kapsar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam yalın çokluktur; yarışma, övünme ve kalıplaşmış özel adlandırmalar bu sınırın dışında tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çokluk çekirdeğini öne alır; artırma, çokça edinme ve azıyla çoğunu birlikte anan kalıp ayrı bağımlı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da ayrık bir niceliğin az olmayacak ölçüde bulunması veya sayıca artmasıdır. Buna bir şeyi çok duruma getirme ve ondan çokça edinme gibi bu çekirdekten türeyen işlemler de bağlanır.

facets.statement: Çokluk, azlığın karşıtıdır ve özellikle sayılabilen varlıklarda sayının yüksekliğini ya da artışını bildirir.
Bir şey çok duruma gelebilir, bir başkası onu çok duruma getirebilir veya kişi ondan çokça edinebilir.
Az ve çok, malın ya da içinde bulunulan durumun iki karşıt ölçüsünü birlikte anan kalıpta kullanılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çokluğu azlığın karşıtı, sayının artması ve bir şeyin çok olması diye ortaklaştırır; ayrıca çoklaştırma, çokça edinme ve çokluk bildiren niteleme biçimlerini aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

error_profile.preserves: Sayı karşılaştırmasını ve üstün gelen tarafı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal övünme alanını belirli bir çokluk ölçüsüyle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da karşılıklı övünme ve bir tarafın üstün sayılması bulunabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir yalın anlamdan çok, belirli kişi ve durum kalıplarında malı veya sözü çok olma, üzerinde çok sayıda istek ya da hak bulunma ve başkasının malıyla çok görünme kullanımlarını toplar. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar ortak bir yalın kök anlamı gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her anlam kendi kalıbına bağlıdır; mal çokluğu, çok konuşma, çok sayıda istemle karşılaşma ve başkasının malıyla çok görünme birbirinin yerine geçmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen kişi ve durum kalıplarının anlam alanını düzenler; bunlardan bağımsız bir yalın çokluk anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişinin malının ya da sözünün çok olması, kendisinden iyilik isteyenlerin veya üzerindeki hakların çoğalması yahut başkasının malıyla kendini varlıklı göstermesidir. Bu kullanımlar yalnız bağlı oldukları kalıp içinde geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Belirli kişi ve durum kalıpları, malın, sözün, isteklerin veya hakların bir kişiye bağlı çokluğunu bildirir.
Başka bir kişi kalıbı, kadın veya erkeğin çok konuştuğunu bildirir.
Edilgen yapı, kişiden iyilik isteyenlerin veya onun üzerindeki hakların çokluğunu bildirir.
Bir başka kalıp, kişinin başkasının malına dayanarak kendini çok malı varmış gibi göstermesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kalıba göre mal çokluğu, çok konuşma, iyilik isteyenlerin veya hak sahiplerinin çoğalması ve başkasının malıyla varlıklı görünme anlamlarını verir; bunlar ortak çokluk öğesine rağmen ayrı kullanımlardır. Bir açıklamada hakların çoğalmasına kişinin elindekinin tükenmesi eşlik eder.

concept_gloss.text: kişiye bağlı çokluk nitelemeleri

error_profile.preserves: Çokluk ortaklığını ve kullanımların kalıba bağlılığını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yüklenen mal çokluğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadın veya erkek için sözün çokluğunu bildiren niteleme kalıbında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Konuşmanın çokluğu ve kişi niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kendisinden iyilik isteyenlerin veya üzerindeki hakların çok olduğu kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çok sayıda isteyen veya hak sahibinin kişiye yönelmesini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مكثر أو كاثر بمعنى كثير المال، ومكثار في كثرة الكلام، ومكثور عليه لكثرة طالبي المعروف أو الحقوق عليه، ويتكثر بمال غيره.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı sözlük birimini cennetteki özel ırmak, bol ve büyük iyilik, ayrıca iyiliği ve bağışı bol cömert önder için kullanır. Dal bu sözlüksel çokanlamlılık olarak korunabilir; bu üç gönderim tek bir varlık tanımıymış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Irmak, bol iyilik ve cömert kişi ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmelerdir; ortak bağları olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın bir çokluk anlamı kurmak yerine verilen sözcük ve kişi kalıbına bağlı üç özel kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Olağanüstü bolluk bildiren özel bir sözlük birimi, cennetteki bir ırmağı veya bol ve büyük iyiliği adlandırır; kişi kalıbında ise iyiliği ve bağışı bol, cömert bir önderi niteler.

facets.statement: Sözlük birimi cennette bulunan ve başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı özel bir ırmağı adlandırır.
Sözlük biriminin ortak çekirdeği, ırmak, iyilik ve kişi kullanımlarını olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesine bağlar.
Kişi kalıbında iyiliği ve bağışı çok, cömert ve önder bir erkek nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel sözlük birimini cennetteki bir ırmak ve bol ya da büyük iyilik olarak açıklar; kişi için kullanıldığında cömertliği, önderliği, iyilik ve bağış bolluğunu bildirir. Bir açıklamada cennet ırmaklarının çoğunun ondan ayrıldığı, bir diğerinde ise bol iyiliğin Peygamber'e verildiği belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: özel ırmak veya bol iyilik

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yoğunlaşıp yükselen tozu adlandıran özel kullanımla bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildiren biçimi birlikte verir. Ortak aşırı çokluk bağı dalı korur, ancak toz görüntüsü genel çoğalma anlamının zorunlu parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toz kullanımı yükselme veya kabarma görüntüsüne bağlıdır; genel biçim ise yalnız aşırı derecede çoğalmayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, toza bağlı kalıbı ve genel aşırı çoğalma biçimini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar; toz özelliğini yalın çoğalma anlamına taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Toz kalıbında, çok olup kabaran veya havada belirgin biçimde yükselen yoğun tozu anlatır. Ayrı bir biçimde ise herhangi bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek olağanüstü çokluktur; toz kalıbında bu çokluk kabarıp havada yükselen yoğun bir görünüm alır.
Toz dışındaki bir şey için kullanılan biçim, onun aşırı ve son sınıra varan ölçüde çoğalmasını bildirir.
Ölüm sahnesindeki tozun kabarıp çoklaşması, yoğun toz kullanımına örnek oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çokluğu yüzünden kabarıp yükselen yoğun tozu ve bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını aynı aşırılık alanında birleştirir; kabaran ölüm tozu bu kullanıma örnek verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin odağı devenin ön ayağını büküp bir bağla tutturmaktır. Kadının saçını tarayıp toplaması da aynı toplama ve tutma düzeninin bağımlı bir uzantısı olarak açıkça tanıklanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, zihinsel kavrayışı veya kan karşılığını değil, uzvu ya da saçı bağlayıp yerinde tutma işlemini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, hayvan ayağını bağlayan temel kullanımla saçı toplayan söz öbeğine bağlı uzantıyı birbirine karıştırmadan gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Devenin ön ayağının alt bölümünü üst bölüme doğru büküp ip veya bağla tutturma işlemidir; bu işte kullanılan bağın kendisini de kapsar. Saçı tarayıp toplama, benzer tutma düzenine dayanan özel bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: Devenin ön ayağını büküp bir bağla hareketini sınırlayacak biçimde tutturur.
Ayağı tutturmak için kullanılan ip veya bağın adını da içerir.
Kadının saçını tarayıp toplaması ve bağlaması için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar devenin ön ayağını bükerek bağlama işlemi ile kullanılan bağı ortak biçimde verir; saçı toplama kullanımını da aynı dala ekler.

concept_gloss.text: devenin ön ayağını büküp bağlayarak tutma

error_profile.preserves: Ön ayağı bükme, bağlama ve hareketini sınırlayarak tutma işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kadının saçını düzenleyip bir arada tuttuğu uzantı bağlamında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dilin tutulmasını iki görünümüyle verir: kişinin konuşamaz hâle gelmesi ve dilin konuşmaktan alıkonması. Her ikisinde de kurucu sonuç söz üretiminin durmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel kavrayış eksikliğini değil, dilin tutulması yüzünden konuşmanın gerçekleşememesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız dil ve konuşma ile kurulan belirtilmiş yapılara bağlıdır; yalın köke genel bir susma anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Dilin tutulması nedeniyle kişinin konuşamaması veya dilin konuşmaktan alıkonmasıdır. Durum, dilin tutulması ya da konuşmadan geri tutulması biçiminde kurulabilir.

facets.statement: Dilin tutulması kişinin söz söyleme gücünü ortadan kaldırır.

concept_gloss.text: dilin tutulup konuşamaz hâle gelmesi

error_profile.preserves: Dilin tutulmasını ve bunun doğrudan sonucu olan konuşamama durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dilini tutarak konuşmaktan geri durduğu yapı için kullanılır.

facets.statement: Öldürme veya yaralama nedeniyle ödenmesi gereken karşılığı ve onu ödeme eylemini kapsar.

Bir topluluğun üstüne düşen ödeme payını ve yaralarda tutar denkliğini kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ödeme tutarı ile ödeme eyleminde birleşir; yükün fail adına yakınlara bölüştürülmesini ve yaralardaki tutar denkliğini de aynı düzen içinde verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi seçkinlik ve değerlilik çekirdeğini kadın, topluluk, hayvan, inci ve herhangi bir şey için açıkça kurar. Korunup saklanma bazı tanıklıklarda bu değerin açıklaması veya kadınlara özgü görünümü olduğundan her örnek için zorunlu koşul sayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın genel çekirdeği seçkin ve değerli olma niteliğidir; korunmuşluk yalnız desteklenen örneklerde ek bir sınırdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, temel seçkinlik niteliğini kadın ve hayvan adlarından ayırır; belirli tamlamalardaki en değerli örnek anlamını yapıya bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun veya türün en seçkin, değerli ve gözde üyesi ya da örneğidir. Kadının göz önünde tutulmayıp korunması ve denizin değerli incisi gibi kullanımlar, bu seçkinlik çekirdeğinin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk veya tür içindeki en değerli, seçkin ve gözde örneği belirtir.
Bir kadının değerli sayıldığı için evde korunup gözden uzak tutulmasını kapsar.
Denizin seçkin ve değerli ürünü olarak inciyi niteleyen tamlamada kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar seçkinlik ve değerlilikte birleşir; korunan kadın ile değerli inciyi bu çekirdeğin belirgin örnekleri olarak sunar.

concept_gloss.text: bir topluluğun veya türün en seçkin ve değerli örneği
concept_gloss.applicability: Kadın, topluluk, hayvan, inci ve başka nesnelerde ortak olan seçkinlik çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bir küme içindeki üstün değer, seçkinlik ve gözde örnek olma bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız deniz ile kurulan tamlamada, incinin denizin seçkin ürünü sayıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnciyi denizin seçkin ve çok değerli ürünü olarak sunan ilişkiyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan bacaklarında dizlerin birbirine çarpmasını veya bacak eğriliğini, develerde bacak büküklüğünü ve binek hayvanlarında bacakları tutan bir hastalık ya da topallığı birlikte verir.

facets.statement: İnsanda dizlerin birbirine çarpması veya bacağın eğri ve bükük olmasıdır.
Devede bacak eğriliğini, binek hayvanlarında bacağı tutan hastalık ve topallığı kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bacak eğriliği alanında birleşir; insan dizlerinin çarpışmasını, devenin eğri bacağını ve binek hayvanındaki hastalık ya da topallığı farklı görünümler olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi bükülmüş bacak bölümleri arasında sıkıştırıp tutma düzenini mızrak, koyun ayağı ve eyer için verir; güreşte rakibin bacaklarını kilitleyip düşürmeyi de aynı bedensel düzene bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, iple bağlama veya bacak hastalığı değil, bacakları bir şeyi tutacak ya da rakibi kilitleyecek biçimde konumlandırmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, mızrak, koyun ve eyerle kurulan belirtilmiş eylemleri güreşe özgü bacak kilidinden ayırarak aynı yerleştirme çekirdeğine bağlar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya uzvu baldır, uyluk ya da üzengi çevresinde bacakla sıkıştırıp tutar.
Mızrağı üzengi ile baldır arasına, koyun ayağını da sağım için bacaklar arasına yerleştirir.
Güreşte rakibin bacaklarını kilitleyip bacağını dolayarak düşürme tekniğini kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bacakla sıkıştırıp tutma düzeninde birleşir; mızrak taşıma, koyunu sağım için tutma, eyerde oturuş ve güreşte bacak kilidi örneklerini verir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel bir sığınak veya bağ değil, çizginin eğrilip dolanması ile kumun kıvrılarak yığılması görünümüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, eğri bölüm ve yığılmış kum biçimlerini ayırır; işlerle kurulan karışıklık anlamını yalnız belirtilmiş tamlamaya bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Nehir, vadi veya kumun düz gitmeyip eğrilerek kıvrılan bölümü; benzetmeyle de içinden çıkılması güç, dolaşık iştir. Üst üste yığılıp iç içe kıvrılan büyük kum tepesi, aynı biçim çekirdeğinin ayrı bir adlandırmasıdır.

facets.statement: Nehir, vadi veya kumda düz çizgiden ayrılıp eğrilen ve kıvrılan bölümü belirtir.
Belirtilmiş tamlamada, karışmış ve çözülmesi güç işleri mecaz yoluyla anlatır.
Üst üste yığılmış, iç içe geçmiş ve kıvrılmış büyük kum tepesini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eğrilme ve dolaşıklık çekirdeğinde birleşir; doğal yüzeylerdeki kıvrımı, karışık işleri ve yığılıp iç içe geçmiş büyük kum tepesini ayırır.
